_meta._description: Model-artifact delivery manifest consumed by backend/scripts/fetch_models.py at Render build time.
_meta._schema: source='repo': use git-blob pickles as-is (bootstrap state). source='release': download `assets` from GitHub Release tag=`version`, verify sha256, then serve.
_meta.upgrade_path: The monthly resale job flips this to {'version':'model-vYYYY.MM','source':'release','assets':{'resale_rf.pkl':...,'resale_gb.pkl':...},'sha256':{...}} after a PASS gate.
